description: Found while building fz-iqp.2; older than it (the deleted ident_cont allowed ? and ! anywhere). fz accepts ? and ! in the middle of a name (a?b) and in an alias (Ab?). Elixir 1.19 allows them only as the last character of a variable, function name or atom and rejects Ab? with the alias error. Builder's Elixir probes; fz side not re-probed by me. Signal: diagnostic fixtures for a?b and Ab?; oracle fixture for a trailing mark.
title: A name takes ? or ! only as its last character, and an alias takes neither
